summary: Tested Date Planner app (FastAPI + React/Vite + MongoDB). All backend APIs functional with auto-seeded movies & restaurants. All critical frontend flows (Landing -> When -> Where -> Restaurant/Cinema/Direct -> Confirm + Email) work end-to-end.

issues: On the captured screenshot the foreground text appears extremely low-contrast against the cream background (could be the in-progress fade-in animation, but worth verifying). The primary heading 'Thank you for planning a day with me' looked very faint.

critical_code_review_comments: Landing.escape() has unreachable code: after the `do...while(...)` loop there is a stray block `{ return { x: nx, y: ny }; }` followed by another return. JS treats it as a labelless block; only the first return executes and the second is dead code. Functionally OK but should be cleaned up.
App.tsx contains an unused legacy `getMovies()` function (~lines 124-160) with hardcoded 2024 movie data left over from the Supabase version. Should be removed since movies now come from backend.

Frontend reads API base from `import.meta.env.VITE_BACKEND_URL || process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL`. Only REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is set in .env -- in Vite, process.env is not natively available unless polyfilled by vite config. Verify the env actually resolves at runtime (it currently works because Vite's define plugin appears to expose it, but using import.meta.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL or VITE_BACKEND_URL would be more idiomatic).
GET /api/movies uses `random.shuffle` inside the request handler -- non-deterministic responses can cause TanStack Query cache issues but acceptable for this UX.
POST /api/send-date-email is correctly MOCKED (only logs + stores in MongoDB, no real email delivery) -- matches problem statement.
